text: 希可儿是面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的 3D 桌宠，在聊天输入框附近呈现 VRM 角色，并通过客户端模块跟随当前主视图会话。用户发送消息时她会回应，agent 思考和回复时会改变状态、随流式文本做口型，出错时显示提示；用户也可以通过工具让她说话、切换表情或执行动作。侧栏按钮可显示或隐藏桌宠，设置页可选择模型、尺寸和模式。启用桌面模式后，她可显示在独立的透明悬浮窗口中。默认使用内置模型，不需要额外 API Key；桌面模式在没有可用 Electron 时会按需下载运行时。

Xikeer is a 3D companion for DeepSeek Harness Web. It reacts to messages, thinking, streamed replies, and errors, and can speak or perform actions through agent tools. Choose an avatar in settings or move the pet into a transparent desktop overlay. Desktop mode may download Electron on first use.
想让 Harness 聊天时有个会跟着回应的 3D 桌宠。
能不能让桌宠根据 agent 正在思考或回复来做出反应？
我想把聊天回复显示成桌宠的气泡并做口型动画。
希望能在 Harness 侧栏快速叫出或隐藏桌宠。
I want a 3D avatar that reacts to messages and streamed replies in my Harness session.
Can I move a chat companion into a floating window on my desktop?
功能「会话互动」：桌宠订阅主视图会话，收到用户消息、agent 思考、流式回复和错误事件时更新动作、表情或气泡。它读取当前会话事件，不负责调用模型。
功能「桌宠动作工具」：agent 可调用 pet_say 显示短句、pet_expression 暂时切换表情，或用 pet_action 执行动作；客户端监听这些工具调用并驱动桌宠。
功能「桌面悬浮模式」：在独立透明窗口显示桌宠，并允许设置指定的 Electron 可执行文件；没有可复用运行时时，桌面模式可下载 Electron。
功能「侧栏与外观设置」：侧栏按钮显示或隐藏桌宠，设置区域提供模型和桌面模式控制，桌宠也可从隐藏状态回到聊天输入框附近。
希可儿的气泡内容来自 Harness 主视图会话事件；桌面模式使用 Electron，若宿主没有可用运行时，会从配置的发行源下载运行时到本机目录。
我想换成自己电脑里的 VRM 角色作为聊天桌宠。
I want to customize the avatar that sits beside my Harness chat.

**A 3D desktop companion (桌宠) for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai).** Install the plugin and 希可儿 appears in the Harness Web UI, sitting on the chat input box. She breathes, looks at your cursor, reacts while the agent thinks, mouths the streamed reply, and can move out to your real desktop to sit on the top edge of any window or the taskbar.

dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · 希可儿 · deepseek-mate：> **Naming.** The project/repository is **deepseek-mate**; the plugin package id is **`dsh-plugin-whale-mate`** (kept unchanged so existing installs, config keys and stored settings keep working). The character is **希可儿** (Xikeer).

dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · What she does：| Scenario                                  | Behaviour                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| ----------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Idle                                      | Breathes, blinks, swings her legs, follows the mouse with her eyes and head. Occasionally stretches, walks around, sits on the edge, or plays a small motion. After 3 minutes without activity she dozes off.                                                                     |
| You send a message                        | Nods to acknowledge it.

dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · What she does：The character is fully local: the plugin ships its own Three.js/three-vrm engine and VRM avatar. It does not call any LLM itself — the bubble text comes from the Harness session it is watching.

dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · Requirements：- **DeepSeek Harness** — the official Desktop app (recommended) or `dsh web`, version `0.2.1` or newer.
- **OS** — Windows 10/11, macOS, or Linux (X11). Desktop mode has the best window tracking on Windows; see [Desktop mode](#desktop-mode).
- **Node.js 22+** only if you build from source or run the test suite. Installing the plugin needs no toolchain.
- No Unity, no Blender, no separate application. Desktop mode downloads its own Electron runtime on first use (or reuses one you already have).

dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · DeepSeek Harness Desktop (the official app)：The Desktop app uses its own `desktop` profile, so `--profile web` does not reach it. Either:

dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · DeepSeek Harness Desktop (the official app)：1. In the app: **插件 (Plugins) → 添加插件 (Add plugin)**, then enter `dsh-plugin-whale-mate@0.6.3`, the repository URL
   `https://github.com/mymde/deepseek-mate.git#v0.6.3`, or an absolute path to an unpacked plugin folder; or
2. With the app's own `dsh` command (**Application menu → Manage dsh Command…**): quit Desktop completely, run
   `dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-plugin-whale-mate@0.6.3` (or the `github:` form), then reopen the app.

dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · Upgrading and removing：The plugin manager refuses to install over an existing package:

1. Quit Harness completely.
2. Remove the old plugin entry in **插件**.
3. Add the new version, then restart.

**Settings → 希可儿桌宠 → 版本 · 诊断信息** shows which version is actually running (page and host), so you can confirm an upgrade took effect.

dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · Using her：- **Sidebar** — the 🐋 希可儿 button shows or hides her; showing her again always puts her back on the input box.
- **Right-click** — a radial wheel with the actions/expressions you picked in Settings (up to 6), the **窗口模式 / 桌面模式** switch, and **隐藏**.
- **Settings → 希可儿桌宠** — model, mode, size (160–640 px), right-click wheel contents, recall button, diagnostics.
- **Size** is stored per browser (localStorage). Desktop mode uses the same size.

dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · Desktop mode：Inside the page she can never leave the Harness window. In desktop mode the plugin opens a transparent, always-on-top, click-through window over the desktop, and she moves there:

dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · Desktop mode：Turn it on from her right-click wheel (到桌面上去) or **Settings → 希可儿桌宠 → 桌面模式**; turn it off from her desktop menu (回到 Harness 窗口里) or the same settings block. The choice is remembered.

dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · Runtime resolution：Desktop mode only works on the machine that runs Harness: the control routes accept loopback requests only and sit behind Harness's login fence. Remote or display-less hosts show the reason in the settings block. `desktop: false` in the plugin config removes desktop mode entirely. On Linux the overlay runs Chromium without its sandbox (an unpacked runtime cannot have a setuid helper); it only loads the plugin's own files from a token-protected loopback URL.

dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · Configuration：```yaml
- id: whale-mate
  config:
    desktop: true # false: no desktop mode
    electron: C:/tools/electron/electron.exe # optional: use this runtime, skip the download

dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · Bundled model：**Settings → 希可儿桌宠** shows the current model's author and credit notice, read from the VRM metadata.

The earlier VRoid-template character (`whale-maid.vrm`, 18.7 MB) is **not** shipped since 0.6.2 — the package is 9.1 MB instead of 21.6 MB. Its CC0 base is documented in [`ASSET_LICENSES.md`](ASSET_LICENSES.md); you can still use any VRM you own through the `model` setting.

dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · Using your own VRM：Set `model` to an absolute path to a `.vrm` file on the Harness host (VRM 0.x and 1.0 are supported):

```yaml
- id: whale-mate
  config:
    model: /path/to/your-avatar.vrm
    modelName: My Character # display name on the settings page (optional)

Or use the environment variable `DSH_WHALE_MATE_MODEL=/path/to/x.vrm`. Restart `dsh web` for the change to take effect. Model files are only served to logged-in users of this machine's Harness; they are not uploaded anywhere.
dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · Repairing exported models：Models exported from Blender often have problems. `scripts/repair-vrm.py` fixes them and writes a new file; the original is never modified.

dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · Repairing exported models：| Option                              | Fixes                                                                                                                                                                |
| ----------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--rest-from-bind`                  | The skeleton's rest pose doesn't match the mesh. Rebuilds the rest pose from the skin's inverse bind matrices.                                                       |
| `--face +x`                         | The character faces the wrong way. Rotates the mesh and skeleton so the character faces +Z, as VRM 1.0 requires.                                                     |
| `--unlit-emission`                  | The colour lives entirely in emission (black base colour) and looks washed out in three.js. Converts these materials to unlit, with colours tone-mapped through AgX. |
| `--expressions map.json`            | Morph targets aren't bound to VRM expressions (no blinking, expressi

dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · Rebuilding the default model：`scripts/build-deepseek-reset.sh DeepSeek_Reset_4K_Lite.blend` (Blender 5.2 + VRM Add-on 4.10) turns the character to face the camera, bakes the HoYoverse/Genshin toon materials into textures and converts them to MToon, binds 13 standard expressions plus `jito` / `wink` / `tehe`, writes the credit metadata, and slims the file with `repair-vrm.py`. The result is about 13 MB. `scripts/tune-mtoon.py` adjusts MToon outlines and shading without rebuilding.

dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · Configuration：Plugin config lives in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: whale-mate
  config:
    desktop: true
    electron: null

dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · Configuration：| Key         | Type    | Default | Meaning                                                         |
| ----------- | ------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `desktop`   | boolean | `true`  | `false` disables desktop mode and its routes entirely.          |
| `electron`  | string  | —       | Absolute path to an Electron executable; skips the download.    |
| `model`     | string  | —       | Built-in id (`deepseek-reset`) or an absolute path to a `.vrm`. |
| `modelName` | string  | —       | Display name for the custom model in Settings.                  |
| `tools`     | boolean | `true`  | `false` does not register the `pet_*` agent tools.              |

dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · Configuration：Environment variables:

| Variable                  | Effect                                                |
| ------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `DSH_WHALE_MATE_MODEL`    | Same as `model`, used when the config value is empty. |
| `DSH_WHALE_MATE_ELECTRON` | Same as `electron`.                                   |
| `DSH_WHALE_MATE_HOME`     | Where the downloaded desktop runtime is unpacked.     |
dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · Agent tools：The agent can control her through three tools (registered only when `tools` is not `false`):

dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · Agent tools：| Tool             | What it does                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ---------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `pet_say`        | Says a line in the bubble (`text`, optional `expression`). Keep it under 60 characters.                                                                                                             |
| `pet_expression` | Sets her expression for `seconds` (1–30, default 4): `neutral`, `happy`, `angry`, `sad`, `relaxed`, `surprised`, `blink`.                                                                           |
| `pet_action`     | Performs an action: `wave`, `nod`, `shake`, `cheer`, `bow`, `stretch`, `shy`, `dance`, `jump`, `sit`, `stand`, `walk`, `sleep`, `wake`, `home`, plus every motion bundled in `public/motions.json`. |
dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · Agent tools：The tools only acknowledge the call; the browser overlay watches the session stream and performs the action, so there is no extra host↔browser channel.

dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · Development：```sh
npm install
npm run build        # src/pet -> public/pet.js (also copies the model if missing)
npm test             # host routes, native tracking, seat geometry, FFI (Linux needs a C compiler)

Desktop-mode checks (Linux + Xvfb; `WHALE_MATE_ELECTRON_FLAGS="--use-gl=angle --use-angle=swiftshader"` for software GL):

dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · Development：```sh
xvfb-run -s "-screen 0 1600x900x24" node scripts/check-desktop.mjs <electron> [outDir]
DISPLAY=:77 node scripts/check-dsh-desktop.mjs '<dsh url with ?token=>' [outDir]
```

The screenshot and end-to-end scripts load `playwright-core` and a Chrome/Chromium binary. Install them separately (`npm i -D playwright-core`) or point `PLAYWRIGHT_CORE` at an installed module and `CHROME_PATH` at your browser; nothing is downloaded automatically.

dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · Development：Developed against DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.5` (Linux, headless Chrome + SwiftShader). Windows Win32 tracking still benefits from real-machine acceptance runs.

dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · Project layout：```
client/            DSH client module (browser half, no build step)
desktop/           Electron overlay: main process, preload, seat geometry, Win32 window reader, vendored koffi
lib/               Host half: routes, model resolution, agent tools, desktop runtime manager/downloader
locale/            en / zh UI strings

dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · Troubleshooting：| Symptom                                                         | What to check                                                                                                                                               |
| --------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| She never appears                                               | Is the plugin enabled in **插件**? Is she hidden (sidebar 🐋 / Settings recall)? Check **版本 · 诊断信息** for the page and host version.                   |
| The settings page is empty                                      | The host side failed to load; look at the Harness log for `whale-mate:` messages.                                                                           |
| Desktop mode says the runtime could not be downloaded           | Set `electron` (or `DSH_WHALE_MATE_ELECTRON`) to an Electron executable, or install the offline Windows runtime included in the release bundle, then retry. |
| Desktop window exits immediate

dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · Limits：- Spring-bone physics is only added for models with separate hair/skirt/tail bone chains (VRoid style). A model whose hair is a single mesh skinned to the head (like DeepSeek Reset) has no hair sway.
- The long skirt has no cloth simulation. Sitting relies on the "seated" morph and spring bones, so there is a little clipping under extreme poses.
- She only follows live events of the session in the main view; tool calls in background sessions don't reach her.
- One pet per browser tab. Settings (size, show/hide, seat position) are stored in that browser's localStorage.
- Windows Win32 calls, mixed-DPI physical monitors and focus/click-through still benefit from a real-machine acceptance run.
- Native tracking is scoped to the official Windows Desktop Host entry and its parent shell process. Koffi 3.1.0 ships prebuilt Windows x64/ia32 binaries; Windows ARM64 is not validated.

dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · DeepSeek Harness 官方桌面版：桌面版使用自己的 `desktop` profile，`--profile web` 管不到它。两种方式：

1. 在应用里打开 **插件 → 添加插件**，填 `dsh-plugin-whale-mate@0.6.3`、仓库地址
   `https://github.com/mymde/deepseek-mate.git#v0.6.3`，或解压后插件目录的绝对路径；
2. 或者用应用自带的 `dsh` 命令（**应用菜单 → 管理 dsh 命令…**）：完全退出桌面版，执行
   `dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-plugin-whale-mate@0.6.3`（或 `github:` 形式），再重新打开应用。

dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · 升级与卸载：插件管理器不允许直接覆盖已安装的包：

1. 完全退出 Harness；
2. 在 **插件** 里移除旧插件；
3. 添加新版本并重启。

**设置 → 希可儿桌宠 → 版本 · 诊断信息** 会显示实际运行的版本（页面端和后台端），可以用来确认升级是否生效。

dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · 使用：- **侧边栏**：🐋 希可儿按钮显示/隐藏她；再次显示一定会回到输入框上。
- **右键**：圆形转盘，包含设置里选好的动作/表情（最多 6 个）、**窗口模式 / 桌面模式**切换和**隐藏**。
- **设置 → 希可儿桌宠**：形象、模式、大小（160–640 px）、右键转盘内容、叫她回来、诊断信息。
- **大小**按浏览器保存在 localStorage 里，桌面模式使用同一尺寸。

dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · 桌面模式：在页面里她永远出不了 Harness 窗口。桌面模式会打开一个透明、置顶、可点击穿透的桌面窗口，让她搬到桌面上：

- 开启桌面模式后自动坐到 **Harness 窗口顶边**，窗口移动时跟着走；
- 可以拖到屏幕任意位置；只有她可见的像素接收鼠标，其余部分点击穿透到下面的应用；
- Harness 最小化或隐藏到托盘时叠加层一起隐藏，恢复时回到原来的位置；
- 窗口贴着屏幕顶部（包括最大化）时，座位会向内收，保证头不被切掉；
- 回复、思考、错误和 `pet_*` 工具在桌面上同样生效。

从右键转盘（到桌面上去）或 **设置 → 希可儿桌宠 → 桌面模式** 开启；从桌面上的右键菜单（回到 Harness 窗口里）或同一处设置关闭。选择会被记住。

dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · 运行时来源：叠加层是一个 Electron 窗口，运行时按以下顺序选择：

1. 插件配置里的 `electron`（或 `DSH_WHALE_MATE_ELECTRON`）——你已有的 Electron 可执行文件路径；
2. Harness 后台本身运行在 Electron 主进程时，直接复用；
3. 否则首次使用时从 npmmirror 镜像（GitHub 备选）下载对应系统的 **Electron 44.10.2**（Windows 约 150 MB），用发布页的 `SHASUMS256.txt` 校验，解压到 `~/.dsh-whale-mate/runtime/`（可用 `DSH_WHALE_MATE_HOME` 改位置）。不开启桌面模式就不会下载任何东西。

dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · 运行时来源：桌面模式只在运行 Harness 的那台机器上有效：控制路由只接受回环请求，并且位于 Harness 的登录校验之后。远程或无显示的主机会在设置里显示原因。配置 `desktop: false` 会彻底关掉桌面模式。Linux 上叠加层以关闭 sandbox 的 Chromium 运行（解压出来的运行时没法带 setuid helper），并且只从带 token 的回环地址加载插件自己的文件。

dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · 配置示例：```yaml
- id: whale-mate
  config:
    desktop: true # false：不要桌面模式
    electron: C:/tools/electron/electron.exe # 可选：用这个运行时，跳过下载

dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · 内置模型：**设置 → 希可儿桌宠** 会显示当前模型的作者和署名要求（从 VRM 元数据读取）。

早期的 VRoid 模板形象（`whale-maid.vrm`，18.7 MB）从 0.6.2 起**不再随包发布**，安装包因此从 21.6 MB 降到 9.1 MB。它的 CC0 底模说明保留在 [`ASSET_LICENSES.md`](ASSET_LICENSES.md)；你仍然可以通过 `model` 配置使用自己拥有的任意 VRM。

dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · 使用自己的 VRM：把 `model` 设为 Harness 主机上一个 `.vrm` 文件的绝对路径（支持 VRM 0.x 和 1.0）：

```yaml
- id: whale-mate
  config:
    model: /path/to/your-avatar.vrm
    modelName: 我的角色 # 设置页显示名（可选）

也可以使用环境变量 `DSH_WHALE_MATE_MODEL=/path/to/x.vrm`。修改后重启 `dsh web` 生效。模型文件只提供给本机已登录的用户，不会上传到任何地方。

dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · 修复导出的模型：| 选项                                | 修复内容                                                                                          |
| ----------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--rest-from-bind`                  | 骨架 rest 姿态和网格对不上。按蒙皮逆绑定矩阵重建 rest 姿态。                                      |
| `--face +x`                         | 角色朝向错误。旋转网格和骨架，让角色朝向 +Z（VRM 1.0 的要求）。                                   |
| `--unlit-emission`                  | 颜色全在自发光里（基础色为黑），在 three.js 里发白。把这些材质转成 unlit，并用 AgX 映射保持观感。 |
| `--expressions map.json`            | 形态键没有绑到 VRM 表情（不会眨眼、做表情、对口型）。按名字绑定。                                 |
| `--patch-materials` / `--add-image` | 补回导出丢失的贴图（脸、头发、虹膜）。                                                            |
| `--nudge` / `--thicken`             | 修共面层的 z-fighting（虹膜和眼白），以及桌宠尺寸下细到看不见的嘴部线条。                         |
| 始终启用                            | 去掉恒定的顶点色、去掉 unlit 网格的形态法线、把形态键存成稀疏 accessor，通常能把文件缩小数倍。    |

dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · 从 `.blend` 重建默认模型：`scripts/build-deepseek-reset.sh DeepSeek_Reset_4K_Lite.blend`（Blender 5.2 + VRM Add-on 4.10）会：把角色转向镜头、把 HoYoverse/原神卡通材质烘焙成贴图并转成 MToon、绑定 13 个标准表情以及 `jito` / `wink` / `tehe`、写入署名元数据，并用 `repair-vrm.py` 瘦身。产物约 13 MB。`scripts/tune-mtoon.py` 可以在不重建的情况下调整 MToon 描边和明暗。

```yaml
- id: whale-mate
  config:
    desktop: true
    electron: null

| `DSH_WHALE_MATE_MODEL`    | 等同于 `model`，配置为空时生效。 |

dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · 智能体工具：| 工具             | 作用                                                                                                                                                                              |
| ---------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `pet_say`        | 在气泡里说一句话（`text`，可选 `expression`），建议 60 字以内。                                                                                                                   |
| `pet_expression` | 设置表情并保持 `seconds` 秒（1–30，默认 4）：`neutral`、`happy`、`angry`、`sad`、`relaxed`、`surprised`、`blink`。                                                                |
| `pet_action`     | 做一个动作：`wave`、`nod`、`shake`、`cheer`、`bow`、`stretch`、`shy`、`dance`、`jump`、`sit`、`stand`、`walk`、`sleep`、`wake`、`home`，以及 `public/motions.json` 里的全部动作。 |
dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · 智能体工具：这些工具只做确认；浏览器端的叠加层监听会话事件流并执行动作，所以不需要额外的后台↔浏览器通道。

dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · 实现方式：- **后台（`lib/index.js`）**
  - 在 `/whale-mate/` 下提供 `public/` 里的引擎和模型，位于 Harness 自己的登录校验之后（未登录请求返回 401）；
  - 注册三个 `pet_*` 工具（只做确认）；
  - 挂载桌面模式路由，并把校验过的命令转发给叠加层。
- **桌面叠加层（`lib/desktop.js`、`desktop/`）**
  - `lib/desktop.js` 负责找到或下载运行时，用 Node IPC 启动 `desktop/app.cjs`（或进程内运行叠加层），校验后通过 `POST /whale-mate/desktop/send` 把页面消息转给叠加层；
  - `desktop/main.cjs` 在 Harness 所在显示器的工作区上开一个透明窗口，从随机回环端口提供 `overlay.html`、`pet.js` 和模型；按她每个像素的命中测试切换点击穿透（Windows/macOS）或在她周围设置输入形状（Linux），并轮询系统光标；
  - Windows 官方桌面版上，`desktop/harness-window.cjs` 用 Koffi 只读取启动官方 Host 的 shell 进程的窗口（DWM 可见边框、物理像素转 Electron DIP、50 ms 轮询）。其他应用不会成为座位；
  - Web / 非 Windows 上由页面每 200 ms 上报 `window.screenX/Y`、尺寸和可见性，这个回退方案没有原生跟踪的保证。
- **浏览器端（`client/client.js`）**：手写的 DSH 客户端模块（安装时不需要构建），加载 `public/pet.js`，通过 `sessions` 服务跟随主视图会话，用实时文字、运行状态和 `tool/call` 事件直接驱动桌宠。
- **引擎（`src/pet/`，连同 three.js 和 three-vrm 打包成 `public/pet.js`）**
  - 叠加层：透明的 `position:fixed` 层，逐像素命中测试；
  - 姿态系统：移动状态、手势层、看向和根运动混合后平滑到每根骨骼；
  - 物理：运行时为头发、裙子和尾巴添加 70 根弹簧骨；
  - 面部：情绪混合、随机眨眼、按文字驱动的口型。

npm install
npm run build        # src/pet -> public/pet.js（缺少模型时也会复制）
npm test             # 后台路由、原生跟踪、座位几何、FFI（Linux 需要 C 编译器）

DISPLAY=:77 node scripts/check-dsh-desktop.mjs '<带 ?token= 的 dsh 地址>' [outDir]

dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · 开发：截图和端到端脚本需要 `playwright-core` 和 Chrome/Chromium。请自行安装（`npm i -D playwright-core`），或用 `PLAYWRIGHT_CORE` 指向已安装的模块、用 `CHROME_PATH` 指向浏览器；脚本不会自动下载。

开发验证基于 DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.5`（Linux，无头 Chrome + SwiftShader）。Windows 的 Win32 跟踪仍建议在真机上做一次验收。

dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · 目录结构：```
client/            DSH 客户端模块（浏览器端，无需构建）
desktop/           Electron 叠加层：主进程、preload、座位几何、Win32 窗口读取、内置 koffi
lib/               后台：路由、模型解析、智能体工具、桌面运行时管理与下载
locale/            中英文界面文案

dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · 常见问题：| 现象                                                 | 排查                                                                                                                 |
| ---------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 她一直不出现                                         | **插件** 里是否启用？是否被隐藏（侧边栏 🐋 / 设置里的「叫她回来」）？看 **版本 · 诊断信息** 里页面端和后台端的版本。 |
| 设置页是空的                                         | 后台加载失败；在 Harness 日志里找 `whale-mate:` 开头的消息。                                                         |
| 桌面模式提示运行时下载失败                           | 把 `electron`（或 `DSH_WHALE_MATE_ELECTRON`）指向已有的 Electron，或使用发布包里的 Windows 离线运行时，然后重试。    |
| 桌面窗口一启动就退出（`Cannot find module 'koffi'`） | 0.5.10 起已通过内置 `desktop/vendor/koffi/` 修复；确认安装包里有这个目录（npm/GitHub 包都带）。                      |
| 窗口跟踪不可用                                       | Windows 原生跟踪需要官方桌面版 Host；其他启动方式会退回页面坐标。                                                    |
| 模型显示异常 / 有黑色细刺                            | 用 `scripts/repair-vrm.py` 修复 VRM，并确认是 VRM 0.x/1.0、使用 MToon 材质。

dsh-plugin-whale-mate README · 已知限制：- 只有带独立头发/裙子/尾巴骨骼链的模型（VRoid 风格）才会自动添加弹簧骨物理。头发是单网格蒙在头上的模型（如 DeepSeek Reset）没有头发摆动。
- 长裙没有布料模拟。坐下依赖「坐姿」形态键和弹簧骨，极端姿势下会有轻微穿模。
- 她只跟随主视图会话的实时事件；后台会话里的工具调用不会传给她。
- 每个浏览器标签页一只桌宠。大小、显示/隐藏、座位位置等设置存在该浏览器的 localStorage 里。
- Windows 的 Win32 调用、混合 DPI 多显示器和焦点/点击穿透仍建议真机验收。
- 原生跟踪限定在官方 Windows 桌面版 Host 入口及其父 shell 进程。koffi 3.1.0 提供 Windows x64/ia32 预编译二进制，Windows ARM64 未验证。
